title: Ovarian Functions in Flight Attendants
brief_summary: The aim of this study was to evaluate the effects of night sleep disorder and sleeplessness, excessive hours spent on flight and UV radiation exposure over ovarian function in flight attendant women.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* day working women , 25-35 years old
* night working women , 25-35 years old
* flight attendant women, 25-35 years old

Exclusion Criteria:

* those who cannot enter the groups above
